endangerment.comment: Awa (vwa-NOCODE_Xiyun-Va) = 6b* (Threatened). Language of recognized nationality: Wa.

hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Xiyun Va has recently been shown to be a language distinct from at least the Lavia variety of the Awa [vwa] language entry of E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 (**hh:phon:Sun:Va**). See also: Lavia-Awalai-Damangnuo Awa [vwa].
